This is a range of capacities, not a list of discrete models — it says "500 kg up to and including 2500 kg", which suggests a continuous range of capacities covered. Hmm — is this a model family? The cert covers load cells with Emax from 500 kg to 2500 kg. The rule says lists of values (comma-separated) are model matrix. A continuous range... For R60 certs, often "Maximum capacity (Emax): 500 kg up to and including 2500 kg" means the certificate covers a range of capacities. This could be represented as type_level value {min: 500, max: 2500} unit kg. I think that's fine. But should model_family be created? The rule says include model_family ONLY if cert covers >1 model variant. The type designation is MQ-S only, with a capacity range. It's one type covering multiple capacities. I could model it as a range in type_level. I think a range value is acceptable: value: {min: 500, max: 2500}, unit_symbol: "kg". Given "up to and including" the max is inclusive — fine.

Alternatively create model family with models "MQ-S Emax=500kg" ... "MQ-S Emax=2500kg"? That would be fabricating discrete variants. Keep as range.
